# Rose Care Navigation

> Private, independent patient advocacy practice based in Boca Raton, Florida, serving seniors and their families across Palm Beach County and South Florida (Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Boynton Beach, Deerfield Beach). Services: care navigation and coordination, doctor-appointment accompaniment, hospital discharge help, and medical bill and insurance help. Care plans are overseen by physician advisors (licensed MDs). Rose Care Navigation works only for the patient and family, not for any hospital or insurer, and provides non-medical advocacy (no medical, legal or financial advice).

- Phone: (561) 299-0526
- Email: rosecarenavigation@gmail.com
- First call: free 20-minute consultation
- Founder: Yehuda; co-founder and care navigator: Chaya

## Family guides and answers

- [Someone to Go to Doctor Appointments With an Elderly Parent | Palm Beach County](https://rosecarenavigation.com/doctor-appointment-accompaniment/): A professional patient advocate attends doctor visits with your elderly parent in Boca Raton and Palm Beach County — asking questions, taking notes, and reporting back to family.
- [Does Medicare Cover a Patient Advocate? (2026 Guide)](https://rosecarenavigation.com/does-medicare-cover-patient-advocate/): Medicare doesn't directly pay independent patient advocates, but 2024 CMS navigation codes (PIN and CHI) changed the landscape. What Original Medicare covers and what families pay for.
- [Help Managing an Elderly Parent's Medical Care | Boca Raton, FL](https://rosecarenavigation.com/help-managing-parents-medical-care/): Overwhelmed managing a parent's doctors, medications, and appointments in Palm Beach County? A private patient advocate coordinates it all. Free 20-minute consultation.
- [Hospital Discharge Help for an Elderly Parent | Palm Beach County](https://rosecarenavigation.com/hospital-discharge-help/): A rushed hospital discharge is the most dangerous moment in elder care. A patient advocate makes sure your parent's discharge plan in Palm Beach County is safe, understood, and followed.
- [Help Understanding & Disputing Medical Bills in Florida](https://rosecarenavigation.com/medical-bill-help-florida/): Confusing or surprise medical bills in Florida? A patient advocate reviews, disputes, and resolves billing errors and denied claims. Most bills contain errors worth checking.
- [Managing a Parent's Care From Out of State | Florida Long-Distance Caregiving](https://rosecarenavigation.com/out-of-state-caregiver-florida/): Your parent is in South Florida and you're not. A local patient advocate becomes your eyes, ears, and voice on the ground — appointments, hospitals, and honest reports back to you.
- [Patient Advocate vs. Geriatric Care Manager: What's the Difference?](https://rosecarenavigation.com/patient-advocate-vs-geriatric-care-manager/): Patient advocates and geriatric care managers overlap but differ: advocates focus on navigating the medical system; care managers on ongoing aging-life management. Which does your family need?
- [What Does a Patient Advocate Cost? (2026)](https://rosecarenavigation.com/what-does-a-patient-advocate-cost/): Private patient advocates typically bill hourly, with rates varying by service and market. What drives the cost, what families actually spend, and why it often pays for itself.
